title: Today’s Subject Sou (장지수) at Music Lab [DJ Ashley's Radio' Clock]
description:
다양한 분야에서 많은 사람들에게 사랑받고 있는 장지수씨와 함께 했습니다.
꾸준하게 올라오는 재미있는 여러 영상들 만큼이나, 입담도 엄청났는데요!

못다한 이야기들이 너무 많아서 아쉽다고 하셨는데요!
다음에 꼭 다시 나와서 못다한 이야기들 다 할때까지, 영상 보면서 기다리고 있겠습니다!

We invited Jang Jisoo this week, who is loved by many people in various fields.
Just like the interesting videos he created so far,
he had excellent communication skills as well!

Sou mentioned that there were so many stories left untold, 
so we will definitely be looking forward to his return and hearing all those untold stories. 
Until then, we'll be patiently waiting while watching his videos!
